purpose: human-first non-blocking input with strict school-major intersection
rules: input state is independent from confirmed entity state
broad major input gets related feedback without automatic selection
school-grounded candidates are restricted to actual school records
catalog-only candidates are never represented as school facts
final confirmation requires school entity plus major code/name record
major code supports editable intermediate prefixes
input and deletion never await network or whole-workbench rerender
stale async responses cannot overwrite newer input
IME composition and paste are first-class input paths
changing school or major invalidates dependent confirmation
network failure is distinct from mismatch
async verification is debounced while local input feedback remains immediate
fact queries are cached by normalized school and major intent
family decision state is independent from fact/input state
legacy workbench no longer polls every 500ms during normal operation
